meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能分析你的代码库，提取业务领域、业务流和流程步骤，并生成一个交互式水平流图展示在仪表盘。可独立轻量扫描，或基于已有知识图谱派生。
howto.when: 当你发送“/understand-domain”指令时触发。如果已有知识图谱，优先基于它生成；否则进行轻量扫描。可附加“--full”强制重新扫描。

say.text: 分析当前项目的业务领域知识。
重新扫描并生成完整的领域图。
显示生成的业务流程图。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your codebase to extract business domains, flows, and process steps, producing an interactive horizontal flow graph in the dashboard. It can do a lightweight scan or derive from an existing knowledge graph.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you send the "/understand-domain" command. If a knowledge graph exists, it derives from it; otherwise performs a lightweight scan. Use "--full" to force a fresh scan.

say_en.text: Analyze the business domain of the current project.
Rescan and generate a complete domain graph.
Show the generated business flow diagram.
